purpose: Summarize the five reachable sibling advisories used to convert v4 fixture requirements into held JSON row values without executing fixtures or closing gates.
advisory_scope: All sibling material is advisory only; Aletheon remains publication authority.

Cicero.usable_contribution: Provided concrete held rows for B_Psi, alpha_B, lambda_T, V(Psi), and metric-action convention fields.

Kierkegaard.usable_contribution: Separated proxy protocol requirements from proof claims and kept Journey/Solas material as context only.

Aristotle.usable_contribution: Distinguished full scalar disablement from coupling-to-zero diagnostics and kept fifth-force mapping in hold.

Arby.usable_contribution: Returned constrained held-row family names and not-run/pass-schema-only limits despite inner file-inspection limits.

Aster_Vale.usable_contribution: Returned advisory common-field scaffolds and not-run/no-closure limits despite inner file-inspection limits.

synthesis_decisions: Use concrete JSON rows only as held values, not as fixture outputs.
Keep execution_status set to not_run for every row family.
Use PASS_SCHEMA_ONLY only for field presence, type, and routing checks.
Keep B_Psi demoted and quarantined unless a separate definition artifact is published.
Keep Journey/Solas content classified as journey_context_not_canon.
Record CLI inner file-inspection limitation without storing raw command output.
